clauses.why: Verses do not say she took him in 'when he fled' as her act beyond inviting him; 'covered him' is supported, but the flight is Sisera's and the citation is fine; shorten to what she did.
clauses.english: invited Sisera into her tent and covered him with a mantle
clauses.ukr: запросила Сісеру до свого намету і накрила його килимом
clauses.deu: lud Sisera in ihre Hütte ein und deckte ihn mit einer Decke zu
clauses.spa: invitó a Sísara a su tienda y lo cubrió con una manta

clauses.why: The verse says the nail was driven into his temples with a hammer while he was asleep; 'temples' fits, but 'tent nail' is fine and 'the sleeping' is supported; keep it shorter and precise.
clauses.english: drove a tent nail into the temples of the sleeping Sisera, and he died
clauses.ukr: всадила наметового кілка в скроню сплячого Сісери, і він помер
clauses.deu: schlug dem schlafenden Sisera einen Nagel der Hütte durch die Schläfe, und er starb
clauses.spa: metió una estaca de la tienda por las sienes del dormido Sísara, y él murió
